   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, January 21, 2020

  CALL TO ORDER
  ROLL CALL: Mayor Pu, Vice Mayor Menchaca, Council Members Costanzo,
  Harrington, Liao

1.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Pursuant to provisions of the Government Code §54957, this is the time provided
  for members of the public to address the City Council regarding matters on this
  Agenda.

2.  STUDY SESSION

  A. INTERVIEW AFFORDABLE HOUSING DEVELOPER FOR 405 SOUTH DEL
  MAR AVENUE

  The City’s Economic Development Division released a Request for Qualifications
  (RFQ No. 19-12) on June 17, 2019 soliciting responses from a qualified firms to
  develop a 1.37 acre site for an affordable housing and open space project.
  Three firms responded to the RFQ and one firm has been invited to interview
  with the San Gabriel City Council.

3.  ADJOURN COUNCIL MEETING

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, January 21, 2020 at
  6:30 p.m. in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San Gabriel,
  California. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

MINUTES OF JANUARY 21, 2020
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Pu called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:33 p.m.
  on Tuesday, January 21, 2020, in Conference Room A at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive,
  San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Juli Costanzo, John R. Harrington, Chin Ho Liao, Vice
  Mayor Denise Menchaca, and Mayor Jason Pu.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto; Assistant City Attorney
  Lloyd Pilchen; Assistant City Manager/Community
  Development Director Armine Chaparyan; Community
  Development/Interim Mission Playhouse Director
  Rebecca Perez; Human Resources/Risk Management
  Director Edward Macias; and Chief City Clerk Sharon

I  1. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Clark.

  Sean McMorris, resident, spoke in favor of the potential project and expressed his
  hope for 100% affordable units.

  2. STUDY SESSION

  A. INTERVIEW AFFORDABLE HOUSING DEVELOPER FOR 405 SOUTH DEL MAR
  AVENUE

  Presentation was made by Assistant City Manager/Community Development
  Director Armine Chaparyan and Economic Development Manager Angelica
  Frausto-Lupo, who introduced potential affordable housing developer
  representatives: William Witte, Chairman and C.E.O., Related California; Rose Olson,
  Senior Vice President, Development, Related California Affordable; Meea Kang,
  Senior Vice President, Related California Affordable; and Jennifer lng -Aram, Project

I  Manager, Related California Affordable.

  Discussion included Related California's portfolio of similar projects, potential
  resident-group demographics and compatibility, financing options, project site
  and design challenges and opportunities, supportive services, open space
  considerations, community outreach, and proposals received from other
  respondents.

  There was a consensus of the City Council to direct staff to bring back an exclusive
  negotiating agreement with Related California for a 100% affordable housing
  development for Council consideration.
